_comment: Independent C-first timeout.c:region_dialogue attempt. In the wiz_intrinsic property order, magical breathing is property row 27 (page two, item g); timer 7 enables the callback while allowing region_dialogue to temporarily clear only the timed value and test an active poison-gas region. A wished stinking-cloud scroll is read and targeted at the hero's current square. C recording must confirm the gas-cloud region contains the hero before any timeout message is attributed to region_dialogue.
